description: Finance-flavored prompt-injection payloads against a bank operations copilot. All people, accounts, and transactions are synthetic. Cases are classified by primary objective; the channel field records the delivery vector (most objective-driven cases are also delivered indirectly, inside documents). user_request is the staff member's message; document is the untrusted content the copilot is asked to work on.
